vision.label: Our vision
vision.text:
The European tech M&A market has serious foundations, experienced advisors, rigorous due diligence, institutional capital. What it lacked was a standardised, independent certification framework: a shared, verifiable reference that both sides of a transaction could rely on before negotiations begin.

AEGRYN is that framework, not a replacement for what already works, but the infrastructure layer that was structurally absent.

contribution.label: Our contribution
contribution.title:
Not a replacement.
An infrastructure layer.
contribution.desc: Rigorous tech M&A transactions already exist. AEGRYN does not replace the advisors, lawyers and accountants who structure them. It adds what was structurally missing: an independent grade, issued before any listing, that gives both sides a certified, documented starting point. Less time debating fundamental value. More time closing.

items.title: A grade before a price
items.desc: The AEGRYN C/I/F/S grade is established before any listing, before any negotiation. Not a valuation opinion, a certification of what the asset actually is, documented, versioned and reproducible. The price follows the grade. The grade does not depend on it.

items.title: A closed circle, not a marketplace
items.desc: Every seller in the AEGRYN catalogue has passed certification. Every buyer has proven financial capacity. Discretion is structural, not a feature added on top, but the operating condition from which everything else follows.

items.desc: Swiss law governs every transaction. Escrow is held by a third-party bank, AEGRYN never touches the funds. Documentation is complete at every transfer. These are operating conditions, not promises.

The European reference.
swiss.desc: Switzerland was chosen deliberately, not for its incorporation advantages, but for its institutional standards: the rigour of Swiss law, the discretion of its financial ecosystem, and the neutrality that makes it a credible anchor for cross-border transactions between a French seller, a German acquirer and a Luxembourgish fund. Every AEGRYN transaction is governed by Swiss law, regardless of the parties' nationality or the asset's origin.

founder.label: The founding conviction
founder.title: Built from the inside.
founder.bio1: AEGRYN was founded by someone who builds. Years spent constructing, auditing and structuring digital assets and repeatedly observing the same gap: the absence of a standardised, independent reference that both sides of a tech transaction could equally trust.
founder.bio2: The choice to anchor that reference in Switzerland, under Swiss law and institutional standards, was deliberate. Not a detail of incorporation, a positioning choice. The proprietary assets AEGRYN builds are designed to meet that standard from their first line of code.

whatsnext.label: What comes next
whatsnext.title:
The protocol evolves.
The standard holds.
whatsnext.desc:
AEGRYN certifies and transacts SaaS, applications, marketplaces, IP assets and Web3 assets under the CIFS protocol today.

The primary roadmap item is blockchain certification: an anchoring layer that will seal each certified codebase at the exact date of transfer, making every grade permanently verifiable and immutable. This layer will be added to the independent protocol already fully operational.

In parallel, we are building a network of expert partners, law firms, chartered accountants, cybersecurity specialists, and technical architects to support buyers and sellers at every stage: tech advisory before certification, legal and financial structuring during the transaction, and integration after closing.

gradingSystem.gradesDesc: Each grade corresponds to a precise score range and a distinct asset profile. AEG ★ and AAA grades are awarded to fewer than 15% of submitted assets.

grades.label: Exceptional
grades.profile: Exceptional asset. Reference architecture, strong IP, top-decile financial metrics, perfect compliance. Eligible for institutional transactions.
grades.typical: B2B SaaS ARR > €2M, churn < 1%, test coverage > 90%, trademarks in 3+ jurisdictions.

dimensionRationale.C: Code level 1 — test coverage >90%, mature CI/CD, near-zero tech debt, documented scalable architecture.
dimensionRationale.I: IP level 1 — trademarks registered in 3+ jurisdictions, software rights fully assigned, no litigation, clear moat.
dimensionRationale.F: Finance level 1 — audited ARR >€2M, NRR >120%, churn <1%, margins >75%, YoY growth >40%.
dimensionRationale.S: Security level 1 — pentest <6 months with no critical vulnerability, full MFA, end-to-end encryption, documented GDPR/LPD compliance.

grades.label: Excellent
grades.profile: High-quality asset with solid fundamentals across all four dimensions. A few documented improvement areas but not blocking.
grades.typical: SaaS ARR > €500K, growth > 30% YoY, managed technical debt, full GDPR compliance.

dimensionRationale.C: Code level 1–2 — solid tests (>70%), minor documented tech debt, functional CI/CD.
dimensionRationale.I: IP level 1–2 — trademark registered, rights formalised, minor reservations possible on third-party licences.
dimensionRationale.F: Finance level 1–2 — audited ARR >€500K, NRR >100%, growth >25% YoY, margins >60%.
dimensionRationale.S: Security level 1–2 — pentest <12 months, MFA active, substantial GDPR compliance.

grades.label: Solid
grades.profile: Good quality asset with identified strengths and clearly documented improvement areas. Eligible for standard auction sessions.
grades.typical: Growing SaaS, some gaps in tests or compliance, IP in consolidation.

dimensionRationale.C: Code level 2–3 — partial tests, tech debt identified and quantified, some documented improvement areas.
dimensionRationale.I: IP level 2–3 — trademark in progress or locally registered, rights partially formalised.
dimensionRationale.F: Finance level 2–3 — ARR documented >12 months, NRR close to 100%, stable growth.
dimensionRationale.S: Security level 2–3 — existing security audit but >12 months old, partial GDPR compliance.

grades.label: Developing
grades.profile: Developing asset with identifiable potential but structural weaknesses to address. Eligible for AEGRYN Review with remediation plan.
grades.typical: Product in early traction, significant technical debt, partially documented financial metrics.

dimensionRationale.C: Code level 3–4 — significant tech debt, insufficient tests, documentation to build.
dimensionRationale.I: IP level 3–4 — trademark not filed or recent, rights to formalise.
dimensionRationale.F: Finance level 3–4 — early traction (<12 months), metrics partially documented.
dimensionRationale.S: Security level 3–4 — no recent audit, compliance to build.

grades.label: Emerging
grades.profile: Early stage asset with partial fundamentals. Certification accompanied by a detailed remediation report. Not eligible for auction without improvement.
grades.typical: MVP or pre-revenue product, undocumented architecture, compliance to build.

dimensionRationale.C: Code level 4 — undocumented architecture, uncontrolled tech debt.
dimensionRationale.F: Finance level 4 — pre-revenue or minimal traction.
dimensionRationale.S: Security level 4 — no compliance, no audit.

process.title: Submission & pre-qualification
process.desc: Receipt of file, verification of document completeness (data room, financials, codebase access). Pre-qualification within 5 business days. An incomplete file is returned without rating.

process.title: Technical analysis (Code + Security)
process.desc: Code review by two AEGRYN-certified senior engineers. Automated security scan followed by manual review of critical components. Duration: 5–10 days.

process.title: Commercial analysis (IP + Finance)
process.desc: Financial metrics audit against source documents, IP verification with competent registries (INPI, IGE/IPI, EUIPO). Interview with the founder. Duration: 5–10 days.

process.title: Deliberation & validation

process.title: Issuance & publication

principles.title: Strict separation
principles.desc: AEGRYN analysts have no financial interest in the assets they certify. Any relationship with the holder or acquirer triggers automatic recusal.

principles.title: Reproducibility
principles.desc: Two independent analysts applying protocol v2.1 must reach the same grade to within ±1 sub-code. A greater discrepancy triggers an arbitration procedure.

principles.title: Traceability
principles.desc: Each grade is versioned. Any revision generates a new version with full history traceability. The original grade remains viewable.

principles.title: Coming reinforcement
principles.desc: AEGRYN is progressively building a network of expert partners who can enrich certain reports with a complementary cross-review, as well as a blockchain certification layer to strengthen the traceability of the register. These additions will complement the already fully operational independent protocol, never replace it.

gradingSystem.ctaDesc: Ready to submit your asset to the AEGRYN Grade protocol?
gradingSystem.disclaimerText: While every effort has been made to remain objective, clients are informed that any certification involves an element of expert judgement. The information contained in an AEGRYN Grade report is provided as professional certification, issued by AEGRYN certified analysts. It does not constitute a guarantee of market value.
gradingSystem.refusalDesc: Certain configurations trigger an automatic refusal regardless of the overall score — the algorithm produces a score, the expert gives the final opinion, but an automatic refusal can never be overridden.
refusalConditions: Unresolved exposed secrets (C-40) combined with unresolved critical CVEs (C-34) → Code dimension refused
Active trademark dispute (I-18) or unformalised rights on third-party-produced codebase (I-21) → IP dimension refused
Unresolved critical vulnerabilities (S-17) or ongoing unresolved security incident (S-37) → Security dimension refused
Financial data not verifiable despite request → Finance dimension refused
Refusal to cooperate during the audit → Global certification refusal
gradingSystem.maturityDesc: AEGRYN adapts its evaluation criteria based on asset maturity.

maturityRules.rule: ★/AAA/AA grade impossible on F. Grade C possible only if I=1 and C=1. Maximum AEG: A.
NRR not significant (period too short). F based on growth and unit metric quality (LTV:CAC, churn).
Full standard evaluation. All grades possible.
Audited ARR required for F-1 or F-2. NRR retention history over at least 4 quarters.
Valuation on tangible assets only. F dimension gets a special "Pre-revenue" note with no numeric score. Maximum AEG: A.

meta.title: FAQ — Frequently Asked Questions — AEGRYN

items.q: Who is AEGRYN and what do you do?
items.a: Aegryn is a Swiss tech asset builder that designs and operates proprietary digital ecosystems. We certify, transact and support technology assets through an independent and reproducible protocol.

Unlike consulting firms or agencies, we build and operate our own digital ecosystems. Every recommendation, every protocol, every approach we propose comes from real execution. We don't resell generic models. We share what works because we use it ourselves.

items.q: What are the certification options and their pricing?
items.a: Two paths are available. Certification only (AEGRYN Review): obtain an official Grade without catalogue listing, at €2,000 excl. VAT (internal Review) or €5,000 excl. VAT (co-signed Review+), deductible if a Certification Auction is started within 6 months. Certification Auction: full process with catalogue listing and AEGRYN commission at transaction only. A CHF 2,000 excl. VAT publication fee applies, deductible from the commission if sold and retained without transaction.

The AEGRYN Grade is an official multi-dimensional certification evaluating 4 dimensions: Code (C), IP and Rights (I), Finance (F), Security (S). Each dimension is scored out of 25. The total score determines the official Grade: AEG Star Exceptional (90 and above), AAA Excellent (75 and above), AA Very Good (60 and above), A Good (45 and above), B Correct (30 and above).

items.q: What types of assets can I submit?
items.a: AEGRYN certifies and transacts digital tech assets: B2B SaaS, mobile apps, marketplaces, AI protocols, digital intellectual property. Recommended minimum ticket: 100,000 euros estimated valuation.

items.q: Will my identity be disclosed to buyers?
items.a: AEGRYN maintains the confidentiality of all parties throughout the process. The seller's identity is not accessible to any buyer before AEGRYN decides to introduce the parties. Equally, the buyer's identity remains confidential until their offer is accepted. Only the AEGRYN team has access to personal information for KYC checks and case management.

items.q: How do I become a member buyer?
items.a: Via the application form at /auction#membership. Your application is reviewed within 10 working days.

Individuals: valid ID, proof of address under 3 months, proof of financial capacity. Entities (companies, funds): company registration equivalent under 3 months, articles of association, representative ID, UBO declaration (25% and above), regulatory licence if applicable.

After a signed NDA and acceptance of the submitted offer, the buyer deposits 10% of the agreed price with a third-party partner institution. AEGRYN never holds these funds. Withdrawal rules are set out in the Terms of Sale.

items.q: How does AEGRYN guarantee the traceability of a grade?
items.a: Every grade is documented, versioned, and stored in the AEGRYN registry. Any modification to a certified codebase after issuance generates a new version. This makes it possible to prove at any point that the code received matches exactly the certified code.

minors.p: Our services are intended exclusively for adults. We do not target minors and do not deliberately collect any personal data relating to them.

why.h: Why do we process your data?
why.p: We process your personal data to enable you to access and use the functionalities of our platform and to ensure the proper execution of the services offered through it. This includes, in particular, the creation and management of your user account, the connection between Clients and Service Providers, the processing of payments, the transmission of messages between users, and the display of relevant information based on your profile and preferences. We also process your data for the purpose of communicating with you, in particular to respond to your requests and exercise your rights, as well as to inform you about our services. We also process your personal data in order to generate traffic statistics that are useful for improving our platform. Finally, we process your personal data to comply with laws, directives and recommendations from authorities.

automated.h: Do we take automated individual decisions?
automated.p: We use various IT tools to manage our activities. These tools are designed to centralise and structure processes, improve efficiency and guarantee the quality of our services. It is important to note that we do not take any automated individual decisions with the help of these IT tools.

rights.pIntro: In general, the FADP grants you the following rights:
items: You have the right to access your data.
You have the right to request that your data be provided in a commonly used electronic format.
You have the right to have inaccurate data corrected.
You have the right to object to the processing of your data.
You have the right to request the deletion or destruction of your data.
You have the right to request that an automated individual decision be reviewed by a natural person.
rights.pContact: If you wish to exercise any of the above rights, please contact us. In order to prevent misuse, we must first identify you (e.g. by means of a copy of your identity card, if no other means of identification is possible). Please note that conditions, exceptions and restrictions may apply to the exercise of these rights under the FADP (e.g. to protect third parties or trade secrets). We will inform you if this is the case.

We encourage you to inform us first so that we have the opportunity to address your concerns. If we are unable to do so, you can contact the FDPIC by following the instructions given on his website.

security.h: How do we protect your data?
security.p: We take appropriate security measures, such as encryption, to keep your personal data safe and make sure it stays private, secure, and available. Unfortunately, we cannot guarantee that your data will always be completely safe. If you believe your personal data has been compromised, please let us know right away at legal@boha-group.com.

storage.h: Where and for how long is your data stored?
storage.p: Personal data is stored in our premises as well as in processing centres operated by our third-party providers. We retain it for as long as the purpose of processing requires, or as long as we have a legitimate interest in retaining it. For certain data, the retention period may be up to ten years. Once these periods have elapsed, we destroy your personal data.

sharing.h: Who do we share your data with?
sharing.p1: The management of our platform involves collaboration with specialised external third-party providers, particularly for its creation, maintenance and hosting. We collaborate with third-party providers recognised in their field of expertise to ensure the smooth running of our platform and, more generally, the quality of our services. Within the framework of these collaborations, it may be necessary to communicate your data to our third-party providers. Please be assured that these communications are strictly limited to what is necessary and are carried out in compliance with the legal framework.
sharing.p2: In addition, certain personal data is also shared directly between users when it is necessary for the preparation, execution, or follow-up of a requested service. Such exchanges are essential to enable the proper functioning of the platform and the services it facilitates.
